bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; repealing customized living rate phase-in under the community access for disability inclusion and the brain injury home and community-based waivers; repealing Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256S.2101, subdivision 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REPEALER. +]

[+Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256S.2101, subdivision 1,+]

[+ is repealed. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2026, or upon federal approval, whichever is later. The commissioner of human services shall notify the revisor of statutes when approval is obtained. +]

APPENDIX
Repealed Minnesota Statutes: 25-02221

256S.2101 RATE SETTING; PHASE-IN.

Subdivision 1.
Phase-in for disability waiver customized living rates.
All rates and rate components for community access for disability inclusion customized living and brain injury customized living under section 256B.4914 must be the sum of 29.6 percent of the rates calculated under sections 256S.211 to 256S.215 and 70.4 percent of the rates calculated using the rate methodology in effect as of June 30, 2017.
